scope: H5 open-arena DCM-control origin-search directional dispersion only
scientific_role: mechanism-definition and identifiability decision; not parameter fitting, ranking, or promotion evidence

decision.definition: At an H5 origin-search draw, sample the angular deviation around the bearing to the frozen origin from the same von Mises concentration kappa_turn used by the ordinary H3-null post-reorientation component for that candidate.
decision.nuisance_coupling: If a later frozen H5 estimator varies the shared baseline H3 turn_concentration nuisance, the baseline and origin-search components must use exactly the same candidate value.

Bonavita_et_al_2026.paper: Discovering search behaviour in black garden ant trajectories
Bonavita_et_al_2026.evidence: Lasius niger reorientation-angle distributions depended on orientation relative to the starting point, supporting an origin-referenced directional-search representation.
Bonavita_et_al_2026.scope_limit: The paper reconstructed directional distributions non-parametrically in a different release/search assay and does not provide an independently validated single search-specific von Mises concentration transferable to the Poissonnier DCM assay.
Bonavita_et_al_2026.implication: The external evidence supports the representation class, not a new kappa_search parameter.

identifiability_reasoning.circular_moment_identity: For a von Mises search component centered on the origin bearing, its first circular moment toward the origin is A1(kappa). The first-moment origin pull is therefore proportional to alpha_history * R * A1(kappa).
identifiability_reasoning.consequence: A free search-specific concentration can trade directly against alpha_search_200 and alpha_search_1000 while moving the aggregate trajectory observables in nearly the same direction.
identifiability_reasoning.aggregate_target_limit: The frozen development targets are aggregate exit time, middle-zone fraction, Beeline, and exit-edge distribution. They contain no direct post-reorientation angular-distribution statistic that independently identifies a second concentration.
identifiability_reasoning.parsimony: The baseline H3 turn-concentration nuisance is already required by the locomotion substrate. Sharing it adds no H5-specific parameter while retaining a well-defined origin-centered circular search component.

stress_audit.temporary_hook_contract: The H5 diagnostic hook existed only in the CI working tree. The job restored src/h3.js, proved git diff --exit-code, and reran H3/RNG/firewall regressions before artifact upload.

tiny_positive_convergence_seam.interpretation: This is a numerical seam at the current <1e-8 uniform-approximation branch boundary inside the nominal [0,20] H3 nuisance interval. It does not affect the current default kappa=2 or the practical diagnostic grid. Frozen H3 runtime was not modified in this H5 design step.
tiny_positive_convergence_seam.estimator_requirement: The later H5 estimator policy must avoid arbitrary tiny-positive candidate values at or immediately above this seam unless H3 is separately versioned/hardened; exact safe nuisance bounds or discrete handling must be frozen before search.

node_engineering_matrix.interpretation: Across the practical concentration range, changing search kappa mostly changes the magnitude of the same aggregate H5 effect and can be substantially compensated by endpoint amplitudes. A separate search-specific concentration is therefore weakly identified by the available aggregate targets.

kappa_zero.fact: At kappa=0 the von Mises distribution is uniform, so an origin-centered search draw has no directional preference despite a positive mixture-selection probability.
kappa_zero.consequence: At this boundary the H5 directional amplitudes are behaviorally non-identifiable as an origin-steering mechanism.
kappa_zero.estimator_requirement: A later estimator policy must report/guard a selected kappa near the uniform boundary and must not count a behaviorally degenerate solution as evidence for origin-referenced history modulation.

degeneracies_and_guards.tiny_positive_sampler_seam: The later estimator must explicitly avoid or separately harden the observed machine-scale seam near the 1e-8 branch threshold.

rejected_alternative.name: separate_H5_search_concentration
reason: No independent external search-specific concentration is available for this assay.
The available aggregate development targets do not directly measure post-reorientation angular dispersion.
Search concentration trades strongly with alpha_search_200/alpha_search_1000 through both circular-moment structure and trajectory-level effects.
It would add a weakly identified biological parameter and another numerical parameter surface without testing a distinct required H5 claim.
may_be_reconsidered_only_with: raw or segmented post-reorientation angle data that directly discriminate dispersion
an independently justified transferable search-angle distribution

implementation_contract.search_direction_center: bearing from current position to the frozen central physical origin
implementation_contract.search_direction_concentration: exactly the candidate's shared baseline H3 turn_concentration
implementation_contract.baseline_component_concentration: the same shared baseline H3 turn_concentration
implementation_contract.event_timing: existing H3-null continuous-time event process unchanged
implementation_contract.exact_null: alpha_search_200=alpha_search_1000=0 reduces exactly to H3-null regardless of the shared concentration
implementation_contract.common_search_submodel: alpha_search_200=alpha_search_1000>0 uses the same shared concentration in both histories and cannot support a history-modulation claim

next_step: Freeze the H5 estimator nuisance family, candidate-coordinate mapping, common-search comparator, candidate budget, LOCO scoring, promotion guards, and tiny-kappa handling before any persistent H5 runtime implementation or parameter search.
